Supplementary analysis. It compares the SoilGrids rasters (pH, clay, nitrogen, organic carbon) with the soil properties measured at each sampling point (`data/soil_data_dry_season_2023.xlsx`).

```{r include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(patchwork)

dir.create("figures/supplementary", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

main_theme_final = theme_bw() +
 theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size=9),
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size=10),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8))
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# Sampling points in WGS84 (same conversion and corrections as in 4_setup_data_for_model.Rmd)
utm_coords <- read_xlsx(path = "data/Metadata_Doreen_070525.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(
    zone = as.numeric(substr(easting, 1, 2)),
    band = substr(easting, 3, 3),
    easting = as.numeric(sub(".* ", "", easting)),
    northing = as.numeric(northing),
    hemisphere = ifelse(band == "N", "north", "south")
  ) %>%
  mutate(zone = case_when(zone == 32 ~ 36, .default = zone),
         northing = case_when(Sample_code == "N17" ~ 86562, .default = northing))

convert_to_wgs84 <- function(zone, hemisphere, easting, northing, Sample_code) {
  epsg <- if (hemisphere == "north") 32600 + zone else 32700 + zone
  point <- st_sfc(st_point(c(easting, northing)), crs = epsg)
  coords <- st_coordinates(st_transform(point, crs = 4326))
  tibble(lon = coords[1], lat = coords[2], Sample_code = Sample_code)
}

wgs84_coords <- pmap_dfr(utm_coords[, c("zone", "hemisphere", "easting", "northing", "Sample_code")],
                         convert_to_wgs84)

# Measured soil data, converted to the SoilGrids units
soil <- read_xlsx("data/soil_data_dry_season_2023.xlsx") %>%
  transmute(Sample_code = `SAMPLE NO`,
            ph = `soil pH`,            # pH
            clay = `Clay%`,            # %
            nitrogen = `N%` * 10,      # % -> g/kg
            carbon = `OC%` * 10)       # % -> g/kg

# SoilGrids value at each point; raw raster units are converted to the same units as above
# A raster value of 0 is treated as missing
soilgrids <- tribble(
  ~variable, ~file,                                ~divide_by, ~label,
  "ph",       "ph_soilgrid2.tif",                   10,        "pH",
  "clay",     "clay_contend_soilgrid2.tif",         10,        "Clay (%)",
  "nitrogen", "N_contend_soilgrid2.tif",            100,       "Nitrogen (g/kg)",
  "carbon",   "soil_organic_carbon_soilgrid2.tif",  10,        "Organic carbon (g/kg)")

pts <- vect(wgs84_coords, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

extract_soilgrids <- function(file, divide_by) {
  r <- rast(file.path("data/raster", file))
  terra::extract(ifel(r == 0, NA, r / divide_by), pts)[, 2]
}

soilgrids_df <- map2(soilgrids$file, soilgrids$divide_by, extract_soilgrids) %>%
  set_names(paste0(soilgrids$variable, "_soilgrid")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(Sample_code = wgs84_coords$Sample_code)

soil_df <- inner_join(soil, soilgrids_df, by = "Sample_code")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
scatter_plot <- function(variable, label) {
  df <- soil_df %>%
    transmute(obs = .data[[variable]], pred = .data[[paste0(variable, "_soilgrid")]]) %>%
    drop_na()

  lims <- range(c(df$obs, df$pred))
  fit <- lm(pred ~ obs, data = df)
  txt <- sprintf("n = %d\nr = %.2f",
                 nrow(df), cor(df$obs, df$pred),
                 summary(fit)$coefficients["obs", 4],
                 sqrt(mean((df$pred - df$obs)^2)))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = obs, y = pred)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "firebrick", fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    annotate("label", x = lims[1], y = lims[2], label = txt, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3,
             fill = "white", alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
    labs(title = label, x = "Measured", y = "SoilGrids") +
    main_theme_final
}

soil_scatter <- wrap_plots(map2(soilgrids$variable, soilgrids$label, scatter_plot), ncol = 2)
```

# SoilGrids vs measured soil properties

Dashed line: 1:1; solid line: linear fit.

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
soil_scatter

ggsave(plot = soil_scatter, filename = "figures/supplementary/soilgrids_vs_measured_soil.pdf",
       units = "cm", width = 20, height = 20)
```
